claim_boundary: This is a reversible primary-form and surface-strategy study. It is not a finished, production-ready, or human-approved likeness.

iterations.observation: The connected U-plan interpretation and center opening read correctly, but the five longitudinal sections produced a trough-like, faceted silhouette rather than the molded wave seen in the product views.
iterations.decision: Reject the surface density while retaining the connected-shell representation.
iterations.change: Re-author the same one-object U cage with nine longitudinal sections and a measured cutter-valley-rear height sequence.

iterations.observation: The extra sections improve the wave path and preserve the rear bridge, but the rail shoulders and end transitions remain visibly angular.
iterations.decision: Keep the all-quad base cage and add a reversible SubD/crease surface test; do not bake a bevel or modifier.
iterations.change: Assign a 0.65 edge crease to every base-cage edge whose adjacent face normals differ by more than 45 degrees, then add live Catmull-Clark level 2 and Smooth by Angle.

iterations.observation: The side silhouette becomes a continuous wave and the rails read as broad rounded molded bands rather than circular tubes. The real U-channel remains open in top and isometric views.
iterations.decision: Accept only the primary representation and surface-strategy improvement. Keep the lower-base molding/groove interpretation reversible.
open_failures: The hub support/hinge assembly is not represented beyond the radial hub blockout.
The lower base now has a complete declared physical-radius edge set and live Bevel, but its footprint and upper interface remain coarse.
Cutter serrations, underside, materials, UVs, and production variants are intentionally absent.
No human visual review has accepted the likeness.
